subject: Constituent Services Transition Team Report
overview: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and Constituent Service Committee Chair Paul Camuso presented the findings and recommendations of the city's Constituent Services transition team. The administration outlined upcoming municipal improvements, including a new departmental voicemail system, website updates, SeeClickFix integration, a dedicated constituent liaison, and live-streamed council and school committee meetings.

items.title: Introduction of Constituent Service Committee
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke introduced the transition team members tasked with reviewing citywide constituent engagement and communication.

items.title: Transition Team Outreach and Survey Report
items.summary: Committee Chair Paul Camuso reported that the team conducted community meetings across the city and gathered survey responses from over 300 residents.

items.title: Constituent Service Recommendations and Initiatives
items.summary: Mayor Burke announced operational changes based on the report, including an employee voicemail and email policy, appointing Lauren Felch as constituent liaison, launching SeeClickFix, pursuing Complete Streets funding, reserving visitor parking, and preparing live-streamed public meetings.
